title: Zero Gravity Croatian Fish Papillote
description: A fresh and velvety Croatian dish featuring sake and papillote, perfect for a weeknight dinner, and dairy-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together sake, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add minced garlic to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Place a cod fillet in the center of each papillote paper sheet.
Drizzle the sake mixture over the cod fish, making sure each fillet is coated.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the cod fish.
Fold the papillote paper over the cod fish, making a tight seal.
Place the papillote packets on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the papillote packets from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the cod fish hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
